      <title>Internship | Retail Network</title>
      <description><p><strong>The opportunity</strong></p><p><span>We're currently looking for an Intern - ideally starting as soon as possible for minimum duration of 6 months on a full-time basis. Someone to join our Retail Network team in order to manage and grow Polestar’s retail and dealer network in Germany. Someone with a passion for electric and sustainable mobility, an interest in technology, and a desire to create and shape the change we know is needed. And someone who doesn't mind the occasional bit of sustainable travel across Germany in the service of a cleaner form of electric performance.</span></p><p>This position is located at our Cologne office requiring a minimum of three days per week. We believe in a hybrid model when it comes to remote and onsite work, knowing that both in-person collaboration and individual time to focus are needed. What matters most is that people get the time, and support, to do what needs to be done. And to enjoy doing it, of course.</p><p></p><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>The responsibilities</strong></p><p><span>In this role, you'll be expected to support the network development team. Working as a member of the Retail Network team you'll be instrumental in delivering Polestar’s dealer network growth, network strategy and project execution. See below for a more thorough breakdown of the various tasks and areas you'll be responsible for</span>:</p><ul><li><p><span>Supporting the network development process for Polestar Germany in close collaboration with Polestar HQ in Sweden</span></p></li><li><p><span>Support network development projects ranging from network strategy, partner acquisition, location selection, site visits, location planning and execution</span></p></li><li><p><span>Establish and ensure retail standards and operational guidelines across all Polestar locations</span></p></li><li><p><span>Provide continuous market analyses</span></p></li><li><p><span>Preparation of presentations with direct visibility to the Polestar executive team.</span></p></li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>The ideal candidate</strong></p><p>In order to succeed in this role, and at Polestar in general, there are a few characteristics you'll need to have. Tenacity. Flexibility. Curiosity. The ability to take the initiative, to meet deadlines and requirements, and to abandon ideas when they're not feasible.</p><ul><li><p><span>Passionate with a strong and self-driven work ethic</span></p></li><li><p><span>Communicator, as it is important for managing our external partners and sites</span></p></li><li><p><span>Structured as we are a fast paced business</span></p></li><li><p><span>Hands-on &amp; solution oriented.</span></p></li></ul><p>In addition, you'll need the following qualifications:</p><ul><li><p>Fluent in German &amp; English (min. C1 written and spoken), main communication will be in German</p></li><li><p>Driver’s license (Klasse B)</p></li><li><p>MS Office (Excel, PPT, Teams, Outlook, etc.)</p></li><li><p>Enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree programme for the entire duration of the internship (ideally 3rd semester or later for Bachelor's)</p></li><li><p>Business, finance and/or automotive studies as a basis desired</p></li><li><p>Ideally 1 or 2 previous internships. However, not having completed an internship is not disqualifying.</p></li></ul><p>Polestar is an international company, with various backgrounds represented. And though we have a global presence, we maintain the growth-mindset. Change happens often at Polestar. But so does progress. Expect an accelerating, exciting environment.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>The process</strong></p><p>If the above matches your ambitions, be sure to apply. Our selection process is ongoing, and the job advert will remain open until it’s filled.</p><p>The Polestar journey is an electric one. <br></p></description>

      <title>Head of Customer Engagement Benelux</title>
      <description><h3><strong>Let us describe the challenge we offer</strong></h3><p><span>We are looking for an experienced <strong>Head of Customer Engagement</strong> to lead and elevate the customer journey across the Benelux region.</span></p><p><span>In this role, you will be responsible for creating a seamless and premium customer experience across all touchpoints, driving customer loyalty, advocacy, and business growth. You will lead the Customer Experience function, translate customer insights into meaningful improvements, and ensure strong alignment between customer needs and business objectives.</span></p><p><span>A key part of the role is owning the customer communication framework and CRM strategy across the customer lifecycle. Working closely with Sales and Marketing teams, you will ensure customers receive the right communication through the right channels at the right time, creating a consistent and engaging experience.</span><br></p><h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3><ul><li><p><span>Own and continuously improve the end-to-end customer journey across all touchpoints.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Lead the Customer Experience operation across the Benelux markets, ensuring premium service delivery and strong operational performance.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Drive Voice of the Customer initiatives and translate insights into tangible improvements.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Develop customer loyalty, retention, and community engagement strategies.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Define and optimize customer communication journeys and CRM programmes across the customer lifecycle.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Partner with Sales and Marketing to coordinate customer communications and engagement strategies.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including customer satisfaction, service levels, employee engagement, and operational efficiency.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing customer-centric team.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Collaborate closely with regional and global stakeholders to deliver a consistent customer experience.</span></p></li></ul><p></p><h3><strong>Who you are</strong></h3><ul><li><p><span>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Marketing, Customer Experience, or a related field.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Proven leadership experience within Customer Experience, CRM, customer operations, or related customer-facing functions.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Strong knowledge of customer journey management, CRM strategy, customer engagement, and lifecycle communication.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Experience working with customer data and insights to drive business decisions and improve customer outcomes.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across functions and markets.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Excellent communication and leadership capabilities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Experience within the Automotive Industry is a strong asset.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Strong knowledge of Dutch and English is required. As you are responsible for the Benelux region, you will also need to travel regularly to our Polestar office in Belgium (Brussel).</span></p></li></ul><p>At Polestar, you will be part of a cross-functional and international team, with English as a natural language for written and spoken communication. Since Polestar’s in a scale-up phase you thrive by working in a fast-paced environment.</p><p></p><h3><strong>People at Polestar</strong></h3><p>We know that a change is needed. We also know that each one of us can help bring about that change. Our commitment to becoming climate-neutral by 2040 is just as important to us as being inclusive, diverse, and innovative. Together, we are creating, collaborating and experimenting to usher in a new era of sustainable mobility.</p><p>We are an electric performance brand, determined to improve the society we live in.</p><p></p><h3><strong>Is this you?</strong></h3><p>If you are interested in joining the Polestar crew, don't wait with submitting your application. We apply a continuous selection process and the job post will be open until the position is filled.</p><p>Are you ready for the journey? Which is electric by the way...</p></description>
